svg.title: Teams connector code map
svg.desc: The Teams connector's main classes and who calls whom. The command line starts the MCP server or the export UI, prepares sign-in, or shows status. Both surfaces call service classes: Catalog, History, Search, Exports, Sender, Files and Photos. The service depends on the ports in remote/ports.py. CsaCatalog, ChatService and TeamsSession implement the Teams-service ports; GraphChannels, GraphPeople, GraphWriter and GraphFiles implement the Graph ports; SubstrateSearch implements message search. Every remote request goes through one Transport with tokens from the shared TokenProvider. The store is an account-bound SQLite Store that holds the chat catalog only. AppContext in bootstrap.py builds the services once per process. Hover an item for details.
